final: WITH team_stats AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(w) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), mean_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_stats) SELECT team_stats.team_id, team_stats.avg_wins, team_stats.avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses, team_stats.avg_wins - mean_stats.mean_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean FROM team_stats CROSS JOIN mean_stats WHERE team_stats.avg_wins > mean_stats.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC, avg_games_minus_losses_over_losses IS NULL ASC LIMIT 10
